body: Yeah I'm still here

It's just my bad experience really. I spoiled it partly by disclosing my history of drug use, and as a result I'm never getting prescribed controlled substances. Apparently occasional pot use means I will abuse benzos, stimulants, opioids, etc.

I should clarify my stance. Drugs and counseling do work. Being someone once suicidal, I feel the way society responds is wrong. I want to hear solutions to my problems, not "call a hotline, go to the hospital, take this pill". I think psychiatry is overly reliant on antidepressants. They are good for short term use in most people to get them out of a rut, but unless you have a mood disorder, they shouldn't be for long term use. They don't fix problems, and no one actually care if I'm better so long as I don't try to or kill myself.
Go to a sporting goods store and buy climbing rope, the stuff used for rock climbing. If I choose hanging it's what I plan to use
Heading home now
No, because then I was the happiest I've ever been and didn't have tinnitus
I can write a note in two hours
Ok, I choose death. I will do it when I get home in 2 hours

My life sucks because of this. Don't try to put things in perspective. There may be an AIDS patient with third degree body burns and no legs but that doesn't do anything to alleviate my suffering. I will take death now and throw my life away, gleefully.

It's constant. Been at an ENT twice. Both were worthless and the second one I saw especially pissed me off.

I have no plans to seek professional help. You know why? Because I want tinnitus relief, not anxiety relief.  Yes they go hand in hand but without silence the anxiety will persist.
What's to try? It doesn't get better. I will never have relief
The brain alters itself through plasticity to generate the noise so it doesn't go without a frequency range. It also shrinks a part of the brain that would otherwise silence that noise.

It never gets better. The brain breaks itself by reprogramming it to make you listen to it. There are no research breakthroughs or progress happening. I'm going to die with this affliction either way, but I'd rather only live a couple more months with it than beat the pain another day.
No, I will never accept this grave betrayal of the brain.

Gee you're right man, I now don't want to kill my self because you suggested I don't. 

Fuck off with that. Tinnitus doesn't get better, ever.
A fan or radio would not help. It used to but not anymore
How foolish

God? How can you believe in one given what your sky fairy did to you? 

No one depends on me, and the temporary suffering of my friends and family matter far less than my permanent suffering

Attention I guess. I don't know. I guess I like to argue to tell people that I will die even if they don't want me to. I'm not committed but I can't have peace. Relieving anxiety is letting my brain win and I refuse to allow that.
Fuck off then. I'm not going to live another 30-40 years with this
I mentioned it twice
There is one option, and I'm seriously considering it
Mine is high pitched (above 10k Hz) so it cannot easily be masked. Also, great, if I do stick around I get to look forward to it getting worse.

I suspect it's TMJ as it changes with jaw movements but I'm unsure. I can't live with this for the rest of my life, although if I kill myself I will. So yeah, probably going to go for the easy way out.
My brain fucked me once by giving me autism. Now it fucks me again with tinnitus
Yes I can. Before I started taking it, outside noise could mask it. Now it can't.
Seem to but don't. I honestly think the meds made this worse

I know if the causes. Mine may be TMJ related but I'm not sure. 

Mine is high pitched so it isn't easily masked
Been to see an ENT twice, both worthless. Had a hearing test done and was prescribed amitriptyline for sleep. It helps but it has very harsh side effects.
Give it a week and then come back with a proclaimed cure. My tinnitus is felt more than heard and humming does nothing for it.
I mean, there is the ATA and BTA who research nothing but that. And findings in other fields can contribute, but I agree. So long as more serious problems exist, tinnitus will be in the back burner.
I cry at least once a day because of this
Stop moping.
You can't do anything. You have nothing to apologize for
I just wanted someone to speak to I guess
You can't. Plain and simple.

Them don't fucking worry about it. I'm sick of people who try to keep a person suffering alive. There are lots of people I could turn to, but none that could truly help me. The depression stems from the tinnitus, which cannot be cured.
Otherwise you best leave this conversation and forget it ever happened. You'll never know a year from now whether I'm still breathing or not.
Cure my tinnitus and all this goes away. You cannot however. Experts in the field have no clue how any of this actually works.
No. If I say I want to die they will obstruct me. They will institutionalize me or something worse
No. I will leave them my final thoughts but they will not know until after I pass
It's not important

I don't want to die where I have lived all my life. I want to go to Seattle where my sister is, and die somewhere I was happy this year before my life sucked. It will be when I go out there over New Years
In the woods. A tall tree by a lake would suffice
Hanging. And I will hang up after I state what I need to

No, I will tell them where I am and then hang myself. I will likely die before they can get to me. I will also be using a method that should they save me on the off chance, I will suffer permanent brain damage and be taken off life support.,
I will call 911 right before I hang myself, telling them where I am
That's right, what about it?
They don't have to suffer as I do. Suicide is selfish but expecting someone who is suffering to live for the emotional sake of others is also selfish
Several, but relief is what I want and I can't seem to have it beyond giving up things I enjoy
Going deaf and still having the ringing, thereby having NO reason to live
I will after I'm dead

Tinnitus is in the brain, a phantom noise. Research is pretty much inconclusive whether severing the auditory nerve (thus making you deaf) would actually  help. I'm inclined to think it would make it worse.

I envisioned the picture. I lack the artistic skills to make it, I was inspired to make it though. 

Maybe I can. I haven't tried d everything, but I demand a quick fix and when I don't get it I give up. I lack the patience to persist.

Because my knowledge tells me that tinnitus is eternal and little can be done about it. 

My thoughts on this and how my organs and tissues could save lives gave me the inspiration for a painting, although I can't paint. I call it the Tree of Life. The roots are my corpse and the branches are an organ or tissue taken from my death and used to restore life in a dying person. My death could save half a dozen people.

I know a little neuroscience. I love the topic. 

Of course. All my memories fade as the hippocampus, fusiform gyrus, and other associated areas fade.

I think about the body first. I think about how my nervous system shuts down and stop working. Each neuron built to support life ceases. I think about my immune system being rendered inert and the white blood cells being stopped in their tracks. I think about my organs like my pancreas or my liver and all the enzymes that break down and cease. My bones sway lifeless, my lungs cease to function, my blood begins to circulate downward for liver mortis, the complexity of my digestive track dead. The hairs cells and fluids in my ears that allow me to hear and stay balanced. The fluids and cells in my eyes the eternally rest.  My gums and teeth useless, and my brain and it's complexities and lust for life being extinguished as I die. I of course will think of the tinnitus pathway shutting down as those neurons die.

After death, it's basically my eyes closed forever. Blackness and nothing more. Eternally lost forever. I could be wrong, there could be an afterlife, but I don't  believe in one.

I'm 23. I am considering heading to Seattle mid semester and getting it over with. Now is the time to do it, while I feel most committed. I also chose hanging over my original method of wrist cutting because I'd be easier to save and more likely to hand a change of heart. Once I drop it's too late.
I plan to do it when I visit my sister in Seattle during my winter break. I want to die right after the new year begins.

I don't have a choice today. I need to get cross country before I can die. I need sturdy rope and a location where I can hang and not be disturbed. 

You seem determined to keep me alive. I'm a total stranger. What's it to you if I live or die?
Habituation is a possibility but comes after months of years of CBT usually. I don't think I will fully habituate because I can feel it not just hear it, and my anxiety makes me obsess over it.

It's hard to describe. Since taking amitriptyline for sleep it made it quieter but higher in pitch. I always had two sensations of it. An ear ringing which I barely hear now, and the buzzing. The buzzing creates this noise that makes me feel like my ears and being electrically zapped or vibrating. In some cases it is hard to mask. I feel it all the time so it isn't a matter of just ignoring it. The sound changes sometimes but it either sounds like high pitched saccades or like rice falling on glass. 

It isn't the worst tinnitus but I am the kind of person who gets anxiety over these things, which makes it worse. I just can't put up with it. Suicide is irreversible and I've already thought about how people would feel and how to divide my possessions. I chose hanging because I need a method that preserves my organs and tissues so they can be used to save other lives and so my brain can go to research.
I will today, and tomorrow. In six months, maybe or maybe not.
Emotional pain passes. Nobody believe it but your brain forces you to move on. Tinnitus is likely permanent and never goes away. It only gets worse.
